componentSpecs.name: LeaveBalance (model)
componentSpecs.description: Domain model interface for leave balances. Fields: id, employeeId, policyId, totalEntitlement, usedDays, remainingDays, pendingDays, fiscalYear, status (BalanceStatus enum from shared/types), createdAt, updatedAt. Stored in src/modules/leave/leave-balance.model.ts.

componentSpecs.name: ILeaveBalanceRepository
componentSpecs.description: Repository interface for LeaveBalance persistence. Methods: findById(id: string): Promise<LeaveBalance | null>, findByEmployeeId(employeeId: string): Promise<LeaveBalance[]>, findByEmployeeAndPolicy(employeeId: string, policyId: string, fiscalYear: number): Promise<LeaveBalance | null>, create(data: Omit<LeaveBalance, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>): Promise<LeaveBalance>, update(id: string, data: Partial<Omit<LeaveBalance, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>>): Promise<LeaveBalance | null>, upsert(data: Omit<LeaveBalance, 'id' | 'createdAt' | 'updatedAt'>): Promise<LeaveBalance>.

componentSpecs.name: LeaveBalanceRepository
componentSpecs.description: Concrete repository extending BaseRepository<LeaveBalance> and implementing ILeaveBalanceRepository. All SQL uses parameterized queries via this.query(). Maps camelCase model fields to snake_case DB columns. upsert uses INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (employee_id, leave_policy_id, fiscal_year) DO UPDATE SET all non-key fields. Stored in src/modules/leave/leave-balance.repository.ts.

componentSpecs.name: leave-balance.repository.test
componentSpecs.description: Jest unit tests at tests/unit/modules/leave/leave-balance.repository.test.ts. Covers all six repository methods (findById, findByEmployeeId, findByEmployeeAndPolicy, create, update, upsert) using a mock pg Pool. Verifies correct SQL parameterization, column mapping, and return types.
